answer_1.quote: We introduce a novel privacy-preserving data reconstruction method, called RMRR (Retrieve, Mask, Reconstruct, Refine), which facilitates the creation of the PsyDial dataset, comprising 2,382 high-quality, long-term counseling dialogues. This method involves ... reconstructing masked client utterances using a large language model (GPT-4o) guided by the retrieved chief complaints.
answer_1.outputs: Reconstructed client utterances, refined counselor utterances, full synthetic counseling dialogues

answer_2.quote: We propose a composite metric termed Lexical Diversity Density (LDD). ... We find that our dataset significantly outperforms existing open-source counseling datasets in terms of the LDD.

answer_3.quote: We assess the reliability of GPT-4o in evaluating counseling skills... Spearman's rank correlation between expert evaluation scores and GPT-generated scores. We also assess the reliability of GPT-4o in evaluating the win rate between two anonymous candidate responses.
methods: counseling skills assessment via GPT-4o rating
pairwise response selection evaluation via GPT-4o

answer_4.quote: Human validation reports confirmed that none of the sampled dialogues in D4 contained user privacy from D0... A user study involving counseling experts further reveals that our LLM-based counselor provides higher-quality responses. We collaborated with two expert counselors to review and revise the counselor's parts.
answer_4.guideline: Counseling experts rated counselor responses on a 5-point Likert scale for eight defined skills (Empathy, Active Listening, Issue Clarification, Open-ended Questioning, Encouraging Self-Exploration, Cognitive Restructuring, Guided Questioning, Non-judgmental and Accepting Attitude) and an overall score. Pairwise response selection was performed by experts following detailed principles.
